# HelloTrail

> > HelloTrail is an outdoor adventure guide featuring curated hiking trails and camping gear reviews, with a focus on Colorado destinations including Summit County, Breckenridge, and Frisco, plus Midwest trail guides.

HelloTrail provides comprehensive trail guides for hikers exploring Colorado's Rocky Mountains and Midwest regions, along with expert camping gear recommendations. The site emphasizes responsible outdoor recreation through Leave No Trace principles and offers dog-friendly trail options.

## Key Topics

- Colorado hiking trails
- Summit County trails
- Breckenridge and Frisco hikes
- Midwest hiking (Missouri, Illinois)
- Camping gear reviews
- Dog-friendly trails
- Leave No Trace principles
- Fall hiking destinations
- Rocky Mountains
- Ozarks region
- Trail guides and maps
- Outdoor adventure planning
- REI and Coleman gear
- Colorado Rockies
- Boulder and Fort Collins areas

## Hiking Trail Guides

- [Our Favorite Hikes](https://hellotrail.com/hikes): Curated hiking trails in Colorado (Summit County, Frisco, Breckenridge)

## Camping & Gear

- [Camping Gear](https://hellotrail.com/camping-gear): Best camping gear reviews featuring REI, Coleman, ENO, and more

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://hellotrail.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, and personal info
